description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5360012273526 SPRING,SPIRAL,TORSI: Line 0001 Qty 100 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0105 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). Approved sources are 81753 172B5224P1; 89954 172B5224P1. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
